single_hypothesis: Decouple free-tail packet storage writes from enqueue ownership validity, removing sample-bound/data_due/push_count logic from wide storage enables.

implementation.primary_payload: same current DATA or VS-selected END/BEGIN as old RX
implementation.data_control_reservation: original data_space(count-pop<4) and eight-entry ring unchanged

ownership_proof: When count<8, tail lies outside the owned ring; speculative write cannot alter a queued packet. If no enqueue occurs, tail/count do not advance and the write remains invisible.
count==0 may expose changing packet_data with packet_valid==0; no valid packet is exposed until a real enqueue overwrites that slot on the same edge.
When count==8&&!pop, the primary write is disabled. Existing count+push-pop<=8 invariant forbids any second control write in a full stalled ring.
When count==8&&pop, head==tail. Consumers sample the old head before the NBA reuses that slot. With no push it becomes free; with one push the new record is at the logical end.
The second control write remains push_count==2. Original capacity invariant requires two free/retires slots, including count7/pop1 where tail+1 is the just-retired head across wrap.

Because push_count, head,tail,count and all credits are unchanged, DATA enqueue threshold and four-entry terminal reserve are unchanged. No pending last DATA or new END/BEGIN ordering stage was introduced.

validation_summary.structural_red: Old code fails UNOWNED_QUEUE_STORAGE_BOUNDARY_REQUIRED with the same final test; this is a storage-boundary assertion, not a claim of old packet protocol failure.
validation_summary.frozen_reference_comparison: 3079 cycles,406 record retirements,389 stalled cycles,full_hold41/full_pop1,END+BEGIN+pop tail-wrap3,DATA-to-END41; all valid/stalled outputs and every owned queue slot equal the frozen old RX.
validation_summary.natural_pressure: Two frames with downstream blocked retain all terminal/control records at count7, reject overflowed data and drop later admissions until credits return.
validation_summary.full_count_boundary: count7/pop1/push2 wrap and count8 hold/pop are directly seeded boundary states and compared against old RX; they are not claimed to arise naturally in that trace.

remaining_limits: No full60/PDS/system/board run was started; root must generate and validate a new snapshot bound to the frozen source.
The storage-enable cone changes structurally, but physical timing closure requires a new routed report.
Cycle equivalence is bounded simulation, not formal proof over every input sequence. The free-slot ownership argument explains indefinite backpressure preservation.
The count8 and simultaneous dual-control wrap boundaries use explicit state seeding; real reduced integration separately exercises natural FIFO-full and terminal retention.
Speculative writes intentionally change unowned storage and packet_data when valid=0; clients must use packet_valid as before.
